Maya (CS): FYI customer 'acme-pay' opened a ticket — payments toolcalls started failing in prod ~03:12 UTC with 400 schema validation errors. They pasted the function payload we received:
```
POST /v1/call
{
  "model": "rwd-infer-v1",
  "input": "Charge $12 for order 123",
  "functions": [{"name": "create_charge", "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"amount_cents": {"type": "integer"}}}}],
  "function_call": {"name": "create_charge", "arguments": "{\"amount_cents\":\"€12.00\",\"currency\":\"EUR\"}"}
}
```
Maya (CS): Customer says this started right after they added system-level few-shot examples to their prompt set.
Josh (SRE): Can you paste the validator error body? 400 response from our gateway?
Maya (CS): Error returned: "validation_error: field 'amount_cents' expected integer but received string '€12.00' (type mismatch)"
Anita (ML Eng): This looks like example bleed — the few-shot/system examples include formatted currency (e.g., "€12.00") and the model is copying that exact formatting into the function args. When examples show human-readable formatting, model will mirror that in the JSON.
Kevin (Eng): Trying to reproduce locally. Minimal curl to trigger: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"model":"rwd-infer-v1","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"examples: Charge €12.00 -> {\"amount_cents\": \"€12.00\"}"},{"role":"user","content":"Charge 12 EUR for order 123"}],"functions":[{"name":"create_charge","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"amount_cents":{"type":"integer"}}}}],"function_call":{"name":"create_charge"}}'
```
Maya (CS): Customer confirmed they copied legacy UI examples (formatted currency) into the system prompt to help the model, unfortunately that backfired.
Anita (ML Eng): Short-term mitigation: gateway should coerce numeric strings with currency symbols (strip non-digits, handle commas/dots) before schema validation. Mid-term: enforce strict function args validation at runtime and return a structured error with "suggested_fix" and a doc link so integrators can fix examples. For this customer we can enable a per-project sanitize_money flag as a stopgap.
Emma (Product): Also update the tool docs to show canonical examples in cents (integer) and add an explicit anti-pattern showing "do not include currency symbols". We'll add that to the API docs and quickstart.
Josh (SRE): I'll land a temporary middleware to strip currency symbols on the payments function for Dedicated + Hosted canary. Anita, can you produce a minimal repro that demonstrates the 'few-shot -> formatted string in args' leak without customer-specific examples so we can add a unit test?
Anita (ML Eng): On it. I'll post a small test harness and a failing unit test in the repo. Proposed longer-term fix: add a runtime flag 'strict_json_functions' which rejects non-conforming types fast and an optional 'sanitize_money' transform.
deploy-bot: deploy started: strip-currency-middleware -> canary
deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: canary 10%
Maya (CS): Customer notified about the temporary mitigation and asked to sanitize their system examples. They confirmed error rate dropped after we enabled the middleware for their project. Leaving ticket open and linked to internal PR #987 for permanent fixes.
Emma (Product): Assigning follow-up to Anita for PR + docs + postmortem notes. @Anita please include repro, unit test, and the suggested wording for the docs.
Anita (ML Eng): Acknowledged — will open PR with repro and tests, and draft the doc changes.
